rationale: This is the third instance of the same two-sided SUMRANK template already tested (CleanGrowthVersusFragileBloat, CashValidatedLongVersusDecayShort, TurnoverFreeTwoSidedQuality), assembled by literally splicing the archive's best long leg (RareAccrualYearsSustainedProfit) onto the archive's best short leg (IndustryNeutralChronicAccrualDecay), so it tests no new mechanism and is a near-certain in-sample recombination rather than an economic hypothesis.

Changing MA window from 5 to 3 on the archive's best signal is a pure hyperparameter tweak, and the stated coverage benefit is illusory since the profitability leg still requires a 3-year MA while the 3-year count collapses the accrual leg to four discrete values, worsening rather than improving portfolio granularity.

Combining the profitability level with the profitability floor into a single conditioner is a legitimate and internally consistent refinement, though the two quality measures are strongly correlated so the marginal information over RareAccrualYearsSustainedProfit is likely modest, and the stated tie-lumpiness benefit is overstated because the six-valued count remains on the accrual leg.

Replacing the fitted TREND conditioner in AccrualBuildupDecayingProfit with a count of margin-decline years is an encoding change with a defensible robustness rationale (a single good year cannot flatten a count), the sign logic is internally consistent, but it remains an incremental variant of an already-tested conditional rather than a new mechanism.

The within-year conjunction count is a reasonable and correctly signed construct, but the reasoning's novelty claim is false — BalanceSheetMigrationToCash already counts a within-year joint event — so the contribution reduces to a new variable pairing, and differencing changes in two differently-scaled at-normalized ratios makes the threshold at zero somewhat arbitrary.

The frequency with which operating cash flow exceeds net income is just a coarse, sign-only encoding of the Sloan (1996) total-accrual anomaly, and the second leg is a level version of the same non-cash working-capital construct, so this is a direct rediscovery of a canonical published anomaly dressed as a novel interaction.
